title: U6 Fundamentals
description: An introductory program focused on fun, coordination, and basic ball skills. Perfect for beginners discovering soccer.

title: U8 Development
description: This level builds foundational skills such as dribbling, passing, and teamwork. Great for young players gaining confidence.

title: U10 Intermediate
description: Players are introduced to intermediate mechanics including ball control, defensive positioning, and small tactical ideas.

title: U12 Competitive
description: Designed for advanced young athletes looking to play competitively. Includes conditioning, tactics, and tournament preparation.

title: Goalkeeper Academy
description: A specialized program focused on shot-stopping, footwork, distribution, and goalkeeper-specific fitness.
